nodes.summary: Kimura's fixation probability is continuous in the initial frequency.
nodes.title: Continuity of Kimura's fixation probability

nodes.summary: On `(0, 1)`, with infinitesimal variance `a(x) = x (1 - x)` and mutation drift `b(x) = α (1 - x) - β x`, Wright's density `π(x) = x ^ (2α - 1) (1 - x) ^ (2β - 1)` satisfies `(a π)' = 2 b π`, i.e. the stationary forward (Fokker–Planck) equation `½ (a π)' - b π = 0` with zero probability flux.
nodes.title: Wright's stationary density (zero-flux form)

nodes.summary: The derivative of Kimura's fixation probability, as a function.
nodes.title: Derivative of Kimura's fixation probability as a function

nodes.summary: Uniqueness of the fixation probability, `C²` form: a function continuous on `[0, 1]`, `C²` on `(0, 1)`, solving `L_σ u = 0` on `(0, 1)` with `u 0 = 0`, `u 1 = 1` equals Kimura's fixation probability on `[0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Uniqueness of the fixation probability

nodes.summary: If `u` is continuous on `[0, 1]`, differentiable on `(0, 1)` with derivative `u'` differentiable on `(0, 1)`, solves the backward equation `L_σ u = 0` on `(0, 1)`, and satisfies `u 0 = 0`, `u 1 = 1`, then `u` is Kimura's fixation probability on `[0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Uniqueness of the fixation probability (Kimura 1962)

nodes.summary: `H(x) = 2x(1 - x)` is an eigenfunction of the neutral generator with eigenvalue `-1`, so `E[H_t] = H_0 e^{-t}` (time in units of `2N` generations).
nodes.title: Decay of heterozygosity

nodes.summary: The fixation probability solves the backward equation `x (1 - x) / 2 · u'' + σ x (1 - x) · u' = 0` (everywhere).
nodes.title: Kimura (1962)

nodes.summary: The neutral mean absorption time solves `L_0 T = -1` on `(0, 1)`.
nodes.title: Kimura–Ohta (1969)

nodes.summary: Moment duality with Kingman's coalescent at generator level: the neutral generator maps `y ↦ y ^ n` to `C(n, 2) (x ^ (n - 1) - x ^ n)`, which is the generator of the block-counting process (jumps `n → n - 1` at rate `C(n, 2)`) applied to `n ↦ x ^ n`.
nodes.title: Moment duality with Kingman's coalescent

nodes.summary: The backward generator of the Wright–Fisher diffusion with genic selection, time in units of `2N` generations and scaled selection coefficient `σ = 2Ns`: `(L_σ u)(x) = x (1 - x) / 2 · u''(x) + σ x (1 - x) · u'(x)`.
nodes.title: Backward generator of the Wright–Fisher diffusion with selection

nodes.summary: The derivative of Kimura's fixation probability: `u'(x) = K σ · e^{-2σx}`.
nodes.title: Derivative of Kimura's fixation probability at a point
Derivative of the neutral mean absorption time

nodes.summary: If the number `X` of copies of an allele among `M` gene copies (`M = 2N` for diploids) is `Binomial(M, x)`, then the new frequency `p' = X / M` satisfies `E[2 p' (1 - p')] = (1 - 1/M) · 2x(1 - x)`.
nodes.title: Heterozygosity decay in one Wright–Fisher generation

nodes.summary: For `α, β > 0` Wright's density has a finite, positive total mass on `(0, 1)`.
nodes.title: Wright's density has finite positive total mass

nodes.summary: For `α, β > 0` the stationary density integrates to the Beta function `B(2α, 2β) = Γ(2α) Γ(2β) / Γ(2α + 2β)`, so `wrightDensity α β x / B(2α, 2β)` is the Beta`(2α, 2β)` probability density on `(0, 1)`.
nodes.title: Normalization of Wright's density

nodes.summary: For `α, β > 0` Wright's density is integrable on `[0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Integrability of Wright's density on the unit interval

nodes.summary: Kimura's fixation probability is at most `1` at frequencies `y ≤ 1`, for every selection coefficient `σ`.
nodes.title: Kimura's fixation probability is at most one

nodes.summary: Kimura's fixation probability is a probability on `[0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Kimura's fixation probability lies in the unit interval

nodes.summary: Neutral case: the fixation probability equals the initial frequency.
nodes.title: Neutral fixation probability equals the initial frequency

nodes.summary: Kimura's fixation probability is nonnegative at nonnegative frequencies, for every selection coefficient `σ`.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of Kimura's fixation probability

nodes.summary: An allele that is already fixed stays fixed.
nodes.title: Kimura's fixation probability equals one at frequency one

nodes.summary: An allele that is absent is never fixed.
nodes.title: Kimura's fixation probability vanishes at frequency zero

nodes.summary: Kimura's fixation probability of an allele at initial frequency `x` with scaled selection coefficient `σ = 2Ns`: `(1 - e^{-2σx}) / (1 - e^{-2σ})`, and `x` in the neutral case.
nodes.title: Kimura's fixation probability

nodes.summary: The slope constant of Kimura's formula never vanishes.
nodes.title: Slope constant of Kimura's formula is nonzero

nodes.summary: The constant `K σ` such that `(kimuraFixation σ)' x = K σ · e^{-2σx}`: `1` if `σ = 0`, and `2σ / (1 - e^{-2σ})` otherwise.
nodes.title: Slope constant of Kimura's fixation probability

nodes.summary: Advantageous alleles (`σ > 0`) are fixed with probability strictly larger than their initial frequency `x ∈ (0, 1)`.
nodes.title: Advantageous alleles fix more often than their initial frequency

nodes.summary: The neutral mean absorption time vanishes at `x = 1`.
nodes.title: Neutral mean absorption time vanishes at frequency one

nodes.summary: The neutral mean absorption time vanishes at `x = 0`.
nodes.title: Neutral mean absorption time vanishes at frequency zero

nodes.summary: Kimura–Ohta mean time to absorption (loss or fixation) of a neutral allele at frequency `x`, in units of `2N` generations: `-2 (x log x + (1 - x) log (1 - x))`. In generations this is `-4N (x ln x + (1 - x) ln (1 - x))`.
nodes.title: Kimura–Ohta mean absorption time of a neutral allele

nodes.summary: For `σ ≠ 0` the denominator `1 - e^{-2σ}` of Kimura's formula does not vanish.
nodes.title: Denominator of Kimura's formula is nonzero

nodes.summary: Wright's (unnormalized) stationary density of the Wright–Fisher diffusion with scaled mutation rates `α` (towards the allele) and `β` (away from it): `x ^ (2α - 1) (1 - x) ^ (2β - 1)` (real powers).
nodes.title: Wright's stationary density of the Wright–Fisher diffusion

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
